summary: @onereach/or-browser preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated 727 KB payload
details: The package advertises itself as a Vue browser component library but its package.json declares a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that at npm install time runs setup.mjs. setup.mjs is variable-name-obfuscated and, if the Bun runtime is not already present, downloads a Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and then invokes it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727,680-byte heavily obfuscated bundle (sha256 9fc2570b7cef51c1b8df116d144d11ff4096357be7d2c4c6367cfc2509cf1bcc) using an obfuscator.io-style string-array with a rotation function, a large opcode/character table, and a runtime string-decoder that renders the payload's network destinations and behavior opaque to static review. The file bears a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header, is named 'math_init' with no relationship to the package's advertised Vue-component purpose, and is invoked solely by the preinstall dropper. The payload is not pinned by hash or signature and is executed under an alternate language runtime pulled in specifically for this purpose, so any installer running `npm install @onereach/or-browser` runs opaque, unauditable code at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
